method.aggregate: Equal-case geometric mean; secondary equal-represented-generator-family geometric mean. Report all six named family counts, including absent families.
method.bootstrap: 2000 fixture-cluster draws, seed 20261015, 95% percentile; keep all target graphs of each fixture together. Family-balanced intervals resample fixtures within represented families. These describe fixed-corpus sensitivity, not population sampling or a power guarantee. Do not pool sessions into ten exchangeable trials.
method.interpretation: Add-back effects are conditional on the fixed group order and pass placement. Do not add median differences or infer independent pass contributions. Compare specified recipes, not theoretical optima, all state of the art, language causality, or hardware execution fidelity. One parameter seed per family/width does not measure parameter variation.
method.primary_cohort: Intersection of eligible case IDs for all R0..R6 arms in both sessions
method.primary_comparisons: Every arm versus R0 and R6, and each adjacent addition on the primary cohort

quality_retention.rule: For every stage separately, count candidate <= reference*(1+overhead) per metric and jointly across all three. A zero reference requires zero candidate. Report denominators and zero-reference counts; speed is separate.

method.ratios: For candidate versus reference: timing reference/candidate; quality candidate/reference. All metrics also retain win/tie/loss counts.
method.secondary_comparisons: Each adjacent pair on its own stable two-session cohort; R6 versus each SDK on stable two-session pairs; R6 versus SDKs on the common all-ten cohort
method.zero_policy: Exclude nonpositive ratios from logarithmic summaries with explicit zero counts; retain every pair for win/tie/loss. No pseudocount.
